name: foxpilot
description: Control Mozilla Firefox: tabs, history and web content (privacy aware)
long_description:
This MCP server provides AI assistants with access to the browser's tab management, browsing history, page search, and webpage text content through a local MCP (Model Context Protocol) connection.

It also provides advanced page automation: page interaction (click, type, fill, navigate), accessibility snapshots, screenshots, JavaScript evaluation, file upload, and console/network inspection. These powerful automation tools require enabling "Automation Mode" in the browser extension.

Before accessing any webpage content, explicit user consent is required for each domain through browser-side permissions.

**Setup:** This extension requires a separate browser add-on component, which is available at [https://addons.mozilla.org/en-US/firefox/addon/foxpilot/](https://addons.mozilla.org/en-US/firefox/addon/foxpilot/). Install this DXT, then install the browser add-on — it connects to the local server automatically, with no secret to copy or paste. The optional secret key below is only needed for advanced/remote (containerized) deployments.

extension_secret.title: Extension Secret (optional, advanced)
extension_secret.description: Optional. Leave blank for normal use — the browser extension pairs with the local server automatically. Only set this for advanced/remote (containerized) deployments, and use the same value in the extension's Advanced settings.

port.title: Extension Port
port.description: The port that the MCP server will use to communicate with the browser extension (default is 8089)

tools.name: open-browser-tab
tools.description: Open a new tab in the browser

tools.name: close-browser-tabs
tools.description: Close tabs in the browser

tools.name: get-list-of-open-tabs
tools.description: Get the list of open tabs in the browser

tools.name: get-recent-browser-history
tools.description: Get the list of recent browser history

tools.name: get-tab-web-content
tools.description: Get the full text content of the webpage and the list of links in the webpage (requires user consent)

tools.name: reorder-browser-tabs
tools.description: Change the order of open browser tabs

tools.name: group-browser-tabs
tools.description: Group browser tabs into a new tab group

tools.name: find-highlight-in-browser-tab
tools.description: Find and highlight text in a browser tab

tools.name: navigate-tab
tools.description: Load a URL in an existing browser tab

tools.name: navigate-page-history
tools.description: Navigate a tab's history: go back, forward, or reload

tools.name: select-tab
tools.description: Focus/activate a browser tab and bring its window to the foreground

tools.name: get-active-tab
tools.description: Get the currently active tab in the browser

tools.name: wait-for-text
tools.description: Wait until the given text appears on a tab's page (polls until found or timeout)

tools.name: take-snapshot
tools.description: Take an accessibility snapshot of a tab's page, returning interactive elements tagged with stable uids

tools.name: click-element
tools.description: Click an element on a page by its uid from a recent snapshot

tools.name: hover-element
tools.description: Hover the mouse over an element on a page by its uid from a recent snapshot

tools.name: fill-element
tools.description: Set the value of a form field (input, textarea, select, checkbox, radio) by its uid

tools.name: fill-form
tools.description: Fill multiple form fields in one step from an array of uid/value pairs

tools.name: type-text
tools.description: Type text into the currently focused element on a page, optionally submitting

tools.name: press-key
tools.description: Press a keyboard key on a page, optionally holding modifiers

tools.name: take-screenshot
tools.description: Take a screenshot of a browser tab (viewport, full page, or a single element) and return it as an image

tools.name: evaluate-script
tools.description: Evaluate a JavaScript function in the page's real world and return its result

tools.name: upload-file
tools.description: Upload a local file into a file input on a page by its uid

tools.name: get-console-messages
tools.description: Get the console output and uncaught errors captured for a tab (requires Automation Mode)

tools.name: get-network-requests
tools.description: Get the network requests captured for a tab (requires Automation Mode)

tools.name: drag-element
tools.description: Drag one element onto another on a page by their uids from a recent snapshot

tools.name: resize-window
tools.description: Resize the browser window that hosts a tab to the given width and height

tools.name: handle-dialog
tools.description: Arm a tab to automatically accept or dismiss future native JavaScript dialogs

tools.name: emulate
tools.description: Emulate device conditions for a tab (geolocation and/or user agent override)
